item.title: Russia Attempts to Block WhatsApp, Pushes Domestic Messaging App
item.description: Russia has tried to fully block WhatsApp in the country, Meta said, as authorities continue encouraging users to switch to domestically developed platforms. WhatsApp states that this move is part of Russia’s effort to steer users toward a state-supported rival app. Russian officials have promoted a new messaging service called MAX, which state media claims […]

item.title: Protests Erupt in Buenos Aires Over Labor Reform Bill
item.description: Clashes erupted in Buenos Aires as activist groups protested a labor reform bill under debate in the Senate, with unions warning the measure would curb their rights.
